name.text: Finding the area of a trapezium

questiontext.text:
A trapezium has parallel sides of lengths {@a@} cm and {@b@} cm. The non-parallel sides are each {@slant@} cm.

[[jsxgraph]] var a = {#a#}; var b = {#b#}; var h = {#h#}; var slant = {#slant#}; var x_offset = 2; var diff = (a - b) / 2; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, { boundingbox: [-1, h + 3, a + x_offset + 3, -2], keepAspectRatio: true, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); // Points locked in place var p1 = board.create('point', [x_offset, 0], {name: '', visible: false, fixed: true}); var p2 = board.create('point', [x_offset + a, 0], {name: '', visible: false, fixed: true}); var p3 = board.create('point', [x_offset + a - diff, h], {name: '', visible: false, fixed: true}); var p4 = board.create('point', [x_offset + diff, h], {name: '', visible: false, fixed: true}); // Polygon board.create('polygon', [p1, p2, p3, p4], { fillColor: '#f0f0f0', fillOpacity: 0.8, fixed: true, highlight: false, borders: {strokeColor: 'black', strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false} }); // Labels board.create('text', [x_offset + a/2, -0.6, a + " cm"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 14, fixed: true}); board.create('text', [x_offset + a/2, h + 0.6, b + " cm"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'bottom', fontSize: 14, fixed: true}); board.create('text', [x_offset + diff/2 - 0.5, h/2, slant + " cm"], {anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14, fixed: true}); board.create('text', [x_offset + a - diff/2 + 0.5, h/2, slant + " cm"], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14, fixed: true}); // Height line and Right Angle var h_base = board.create('point', [x_offset + diff, 0], {visible: false, fixed: true}); board.create('segment', [p4, h_base], { dash: 2, strokeColor: 'gray', strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true }); board.create('angle', [p2, h_base, p4], {radius: Math.min(1, a*0.1), type: 'square', strokeColor: 'gray', fixed: true, name: ''}); board.create('text', [x_offset + diff + 0.3, h/2, "h"], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 14, fixed: true}); [[/jsxgraph]]

Calculate the area of the trapezium.

Area = [[input:ans1]] \(\text{cm}^2\) [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Step 1: Find the base of the side triangle.
Because the trapezium is isosceles, the difference between the parallel sides is shared equally:

\[ \text{Side base} = \frac{{@a@} - {@b@}}{2} = \frac{{@a-b@}}{2} = {@diff_single@} \text{ cm} \]

Step 2: Calculate height (\(h\)) using Pythagoras.

\[ h^2 + {@diff_single@}^2 = {@slant@}^2 \] \[ h^2 + {@diff_single_sq@} = {@slant_sq@} \] \[ h^2 = {@slant_sq@} - {@diff_single_sq@} \] \[ h^2 = {@h_sq@} \implies h = {@h@} \text{ cm} \]

Step 3: Calculate the Area.

\[ \text{Area} = \frac{1}{2}(a + b) \times h \] \[ \text{Area} = \frac{1}{2}({@a@} + {@b@}) \times {@h@} \] \[ \text{Area} = \frac{1}{2}({@sum_ab@}) \times {@h@} \] \[ \text{Area} = {@ta1@} \text{ cm}^2 \]

truefeedback.text: You forgot to multiply by the factor \(\frac{1}{2}\). Check the formula in the worked solution.
You used the slanted side instead of the perpendicular height (\(h\)) to find the area. You must use Pythagoras' theorem to find \(h\) first.
You incorrectly added all four sides. Remember, only the parallel sides are used in the trapezium area formula.
